ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 78% high-intensity white to 22% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the central and distal lobe areas. Low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated at the peduncle junction (forming a jagged 'W' shape) and extending as a continuous perimeter band (5-12 pixel width) along the trailing and leading edges. Approximately 12 discrete circular dark blobs (2-6 pixels diameter) distributed across the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped angle of 62 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 55 pixels from the median lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks every 10-15 pixels) along the left lobe. Right lobe displays similar serrations interrupted by a major negative-amplitude deviation (trauma-induced notch) at the distal 2/3 position.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Compound curve characterized by concavity near the central notch transitioning to a strong convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of circular low-intensity pixel clusters: 4 clusters on the upper-mid left lobe and 8 clusters distributed across the central and lower right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical low-intensity linear disruptions detected on the right lobe surface, roughly parallel to the longitudinal axis of the whale.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent semi-circular excision of tissue (missing mass) located on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately 75% lateral to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The black-to-white transition boundary at the peduncle base exhibits a high-contrast, jagged 'splatter' effect rather than a smooth gradient.
